text:
Ryan: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered deps/lockfile rollforward across runtime, infra, and apps to avoid CI storm. Cutoff is Thu Aug 10 22:00 UTC. Plan: runtime -> infra (vendor) -> docs -> apps. I will open WIP PRs and mark them with `ci:staggered` so CI queues are throttled.

Alice: Ack. timeline looks fine. Where should we put changelog notes?

Ryan: Add changelog entries in each repo under `CHANGELOG.md` and mention the release tag `v3.7.0-rc`. I'll copy a template into the runtime PR description.

Bob: Two quick questions: 1) vendor build is heavy — can we avoid rebuilding it for runtime-only bumps? 2) who owns the submodule pointer update?

Ryan: Good call. Vendor rebuild only when infra bump changes vendor files. Runtime bumps should be just lockfile/requirements updates. Carol — can you own the runtime PRs? Dave — can you handle infra/vendor submodule updates and coordinate the heavy CI?

Carol: I can take runtime. I'll pin `protobuf` -> 3.20 in the runtime lockfile and add a changelog line: "pin protobuf for inference runtime stability". I'll open PR shortly (WIP).

Dave: I'll own infra/vendor. Plan for vendor: update `vendor/third_party` submodule pointer and include a separate PR that only touches vendor artifacts. CI: I'll gate the vendor-heavy jobs behind the `ci:vendor` label and ask for manual approval before heavy builds. Snippet I'll use: 
```
# update submodule to latest vetted commit
git submodule update --init vendor/third_party
git fetch vendor/third_party origin
git checkout <vetted-commit>
git add vendor/third_party && git commit -m "update vendor/third_party -> <vetted-commit>"
```
Also, please do not merge anything into `release/cutoff` branch that touches `vendor/` until my PR is merged.

Sara: I can run a quick canary smoke once runtime PR lands. Please ping me with the PR URL and I'll queue `canary/run-smoke`.

Alice: Also reminder — if your PR changes runtime model manifests, please run local evals against the small prompt set (we keep a `prompts/sanity/` set). We want to avoid any perf regressions before cutoff.

Carol: noted. I'll run `scripts/eval_local.sh prompts/sanity` and paste results in the PR.

Bob: tagging reviewers — @Alice for changelog, @Sara for canary plan, @Dave for vendor gating. Also add a short reviewer checklist in PR body: impacted area, smoke result link, changelog line, CI label.

Ryan: I'll send a short email to the release mailing list with the staggered window and the merge freeze rules after these PRs are up. Also: please rebase your PRs onto `release/cutoff` and mark as WIP until CI green + canary smoke.

devops-bot: ci:vendor build queued for PR #4321 (awaiting manual approval) :hourglass:

Dave: Manual approval needed on #4321. I'm holding off until runtime PR merges and smoke passes.

Carol: Runtime PR #4318 is ready for review (WIP -> ready after tests). Ran `scripts/eval_local.sh` — no regressions. Pushed changelog entry.

Alice: Reviewing #4318 now, will add changelog LGTM and small edits.

Bob: tiny nit in #4318, left comments. Nothing blocking.

Sara: Can confirm I'll run canary once comments are addressed and tests green. Ping me in thread.

Ryan: Thanks all. Final reminder: hold merges touching `vendor/` or `submodule` until Dave's PR merges and vendor job is approved. If you need to cut a minimal hotfix after cutoff, ping me and we'll coordinate a narrowly-scoped exception. :thumbsup:

Dave: Approved vendor build and will merge immediately after runtime canary is green.

devops-bot: PR #4321: ci:vendor build started :rocket

Carol: Can we add a short release note entry in the runtime PR with the guidance: "no functional changes, dependency pin only" so QA doesn't re-run full regression?

Alice: Done — added that note to #4318.

Ryan: Solid. I'll post the schedule in the release checklist doc and tag everyone. If anything slips, we'll postpone vendor merge to the next window. :eyes:
